scientific_question: Can the existing query-to-fact-clause identity signal remain available across the full answer span and improve native greedy generation without sacrificing the established relational/language/binding behavior?
hypothesis: The current pointer retrieves a useful identity-bearing fact-clause state but the ordinary LM head never receives it. A minimal persistent route to every answer prediction position should reduce first-token-correct-then-diverge failures.
scientific_variable: one zero-initialized per-channel persistent pointer-source route

route.name: persistent_pointer_source_route
route.source: existing cosine pointer over fact-clause spans
route.candidate_anchor: mean final-normalized hidden state over each existing fact-clause span through its period
route.application: add retrieved * route_gate elementwise to every hidden state at positions prompt_len-1 and later, then frozen existing language head
route.route_gate: trainable vector [640], initialized exactly zero; only new parameter; no identity labels or correct-answer route used
route.neutral_state: route_gate=0 reproduces parent path; preflight U0 DEV CE exactly 1.2040123894810677
route.extra_forwards: none beyond inherited per-record teacher-forced forwards; no generated-prefix training rollouts

inherited_objective.answer_ce: full teacher-forced candidate token span + EOS
inherited_objective.unlikelihood: inherited T24 inventory-wide frozen 24-name token unlikelihood

schedule.phase_a: updates 1-750; inherited early blocks 0-3 frozen plus route_gate trainable
schedule.phase_b: after U750 restore parent blocks 8-11, inherited phase-B scope plus route_gate
schedule.batch: 32 QA/update via inherited microbatch 8; schedules mapped deterministically 860001->870001, 860002->870002, 860003->870003
schedule.optimizer: AdamW betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.05, foreach=False, fused=False

scope.early_blocks: inherited blocks 0-3 frozen; phase B additionally restores/freezes blocks 8-11 as inherited

evaluation.data: C:\DaveLM-CADAVER\phase2a_t3_rebuilt_study_v1\data\qa_train.jsonl + qa_dev.jsonl + acq16.json + panels.json; DEV only for terminal reporting; T3_TEST never loaded

gates.representation: pointer >=96/128, pointer reversals >=48/64, complete pointer families >=8/16, name-disjoint >=48/64, template-disjoint >=48/64
gates.study: >=2 full => T30_FULL_SUCCESS; >=2 representation-success/output-fail => T30_REPRESENTATION_SUCCESS_OUTPUT_FAIL; otherwise T30_FAIL_NO_REPRESENTATION; any integrity/language/binding hard stop => T30_HARD_STOP

hard_stops: binding or inherited frozen early block mutation
restart: rolling_restart.pt includes model, optimizer, phase, completed update; resume only same seed/output and frozen protocol; no replacement seeds
status_rule: This protocol is sealed before training. Do not tune route gate, scope, schedule, seeds, loss, gates, or data after observing outcomes. Stop after all three seed adjudications; do not launch T31.
